free_tier.stated: Lowest-priority (batch, most interruptible) price per GPU-hour on the vendor pricing page, read 2026-11-03: RTX 3090 24 GB USD 0.090, RTX 4090 24 GB USD 0.160 and RTX 5090 32 GB USD 0.250; the RTX 4090 costs USD 0.253 at Low, 0.347 at Medium and 0.440 at High priority. Billing is per second while the instance runs. The page lists no L40S, H100, A100 or L4.

retention.stated: Community nodes are the lowest priority tier and are preempted by higher-priority workloads, so a job that must run to completion cannot rely on holding the card.

chaining: At USD 0.09 a 3090-hour, USD 10 buys 111 hours on a 24 GB card, which is the cheapest way to run a long checkpointed fine-tune; the preemption risk is what the discount pays for.
